name: Hoshino Kanata
source:
Hobbies: Investigating/Surveying 
Special Skill(s): Memory Manipulation, Gravity Control
Favorite Food: Curry
Least Favorite Food: Inorganic Compound

A boy the protagonist met underneath the "Legendary Tree".
He's rather eccentric, but somehow his presence is weak and he doesn't get talked about much.
The alien on his shoulder seems to be a stuffed animal, but sometimes it can be seen talking and moving.
